target.title: feat(site): Switchboard keycap redesign for the product site (before/after)
target.body:
## Switchboard redesign — product site

Companion to #56 (the app redesign). The marketing site at `clickclack.chat` now speaks the same "Switchboard" mechanical-keycap language: porcelain surfaces over a dot-grid mounting plate in light mode, an anodized navy-black night board in dark mode, electric cyan signal accent, and controls that press like keys.

### What changed

- **Palette** (`--ps-*` tokens in `product.css`): warm paper/ember → cool ink + cyan; the secondary hue moves from teal to the app's agent-delivery indigo (bot presence, thread hints, bot avatar). Terminal panel re-tinted navy with a cyan prompt.
- **Type**: Bricolage Grotesque for the brand, h1/h2/h3; kickers and mockup side-labels become mono plate legends; code/time already mono via a new `--ps-mono` token.
- **Tactility**: `--ps-key-edge` keycap treatment on the brand mark, CTA buttons (raised on hover, pressed flat on `:active`), quickstart step keys, and the hero install chip.
- **Texture**: dot-grid plate + faint cyan glow behind the whole page.
- **Mockup**: the fake app frame's avatars/accents re-tuned to the new palette (cobalt/indigo/amber), presence green matched to the app's success token.

No markup changes — `ProductSite.svelte` is untouched; the whole diff is `product.css` plus the shared font dependency.

### Before / after

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| **Light** | ![before light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard-site/docs/proof/switchboard-site-before-light.png) | ![after light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard-site/docs/proof/switchboard-site-after-light.png) |
| **Dark** | ![before dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard-site/docs/proof/switchboard-site-before-dark.png) | ![after dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard-site/docs/proof/switchboard-site-after-dark.png) |
| **Mobile** | ![before mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard-site/docs/proof/switchboard-site-before-mobile.png) | ![after mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard-site/docs/proof/switchboard-site-after-mobile.png) |

### Verification

- `pnpm fmt:ts:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build:web` green.
- Autoreview (Codex gpt-5.6-sol, xhigh): clean on first pass.

### Notes

- Branched off `main`, independent of #56. Both PRs add the same `@fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque` dependency, so whichever lands second needs a trivial lockfile rebase.
- `favicon.svg` (the coral claw mark, used by both app and site) is deliberately untouched — recoloring the logo itself is a brand call I didn't want to bury in a CSS PR. Happy to follow up if wanted.
